tools.offline_strategy: Keep installer or portable archive in downloads/installers and export repository bundles.

fallbacks: uv standalone binary cached in FORGE_HOME/bin
tools.offline_strategy: Cache uv binary plus Python wheels in downloads/wheelhouse.
Keep a known-good static/portable build under downloads/ffmpeg and copy it into FORGE_HOME/bin.
Preserve package-lock files and npm cache; export built frontend assets for no-Node runtime use.
Prefer cached release binaries; retain source tarballs only when builds are necessary.
Store models under FORGE_HOME/models/ollama and keep a model inventory with hashes/sizes.

tools.windows_install: Use Forge install_llama_cpp.ps1 or winget install llama.cpp
tools.offline_strategy: Cache official release binaries plus a retained GGUF model under FORGE_HOME/models/llama.cpp.

tools.windows_install: Use official whisper.cpp Windows release or build with CMake
tools.offline_strategy: Cache executable plus ggml model files under FORGE_HOME/models/whisper.
Export critical container images with podman save and keep them in downloads/containers.
Export a configured distro with wsl --export so it can be restored later.

tools.windows_install: Use Forge install_12ui.ps1. It prefers a retained offline runtime, then an online npm install when available.
fallbacks: Forge deterministic local HTML/CSS design system
tools.offline_strategy: After one successful online install, archive the complete 12ui Node runtime plus npm cache under FORGE_HOME/downloads/npm-packages. 12ui hosted design calls can still require internet/service access, so local Forge Design is the guaranteed offline route.
